# John Braybrooke

> Street and observational photography and field notes by John Braybrooke.
> Each photograph and note has a standalone page with crawlable metadata.

## Photographs

- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/1/): An empty powder-blue metal folding chair sits alone on a plaza paved with irregular flagstones and red brick. Behind it, a person in a blue dress walks a small cream-coloured dog on a leash. To the right, a plywood board mounted outdoors displays a historical town map and black-and-white archival photographs. Bright midday sun throws hard shadows across the stone.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/2/): A view through the glass front of a clinic. White and yellow vinyl lettering on the window reads 'ACUPUNCTURE', 'SHOCKWAVE' and 'ICBC PROVIDER'. Behind and reflected in the glass, a man with closely cropped hair is seen from behind in a dark patterned sweatshirt printed with a 'Blue Moose — Hope, British Columbia, Canada' logo. A white moulded chair stands in the foreground while reflections of the street layer over the interior.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/3/): A pale blue ceramic dog bowl, decorated with a black bone and a chevron band and filled with water, rests on a sunlit concrete sidewalk. Beside it stands a black A-frame sandwich board for The Parkside Brewery, illustrated with a yellow iced drink, a lemon slice and a red straw, above the words 'PURCHASE … FOR … BEER'. Strong angular shadows cross the pavement.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/4/): Photographed from the sidewalk through a shop window. A black-and-white 'OPEN' sign hangs from a beaded chain on a suction cup against the dark glass. Behind it, inside the shop, stands a mannequin of a man in a red mesh tank top, dramatically lit so he seems to gaze out through the glass toward the street.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/5/): Seen from outside through a window, a rounded white soft-toy figure in a pink polka-dot dress stands on an interior sill among other small objects. Green oak-leaf foliage fills the lower foreground, and the building's orange and yellow walls frame the glass.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/6/): Photographed from below, the corner of a billboard cuts diagonally across a blue sky streaked with thin cloud. A black floodlight reaches out on an arm to light the board, which shows a woman with wind-blown dark hair and white sunglasses, smiling, her image skewed by the steep upward angle.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/8/): Two life-size cardboard cutouts of women's faces rise just above a dense green hedge, positioned in front of a building's large windows so they seem to peer over the foliage. The glass behind them reflects trees and a neighbouring building.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/9/): Large and small versions of the same smiling face appear on a textured white masonry wall. The large portrait is rendered in black halftone dots across overlapping sheets of pasted paper and crossed on the right by purple spray paint. A smaller version sits at the upper left among cropped black lettering, while hard sunlight throws diagonal shadows over the paper and wall.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/10/): A white plastic road barricade leans to one side at the edge of a sidewalk, its long rail marked with alternating orange and white diagonal stripes. Behind it, ornamental grass grows in a rust-coloured planter beneath a dark shop window displaying small bags. Strong sunlight casts crisp tree shadows and the silhouette of a person across the concrete wall, paving and barricade.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/11/): A temporary white sign fills a shallow recess in a pale grey stucco wall. Large red capital letters read 'FRESH BEER THIS WAY' above a broad arrow pointing right. The sign is held in place by wrinkled beige paper and many strips of masking tape, with leaf shadows falling across it and a beer keg partly visible at the far right.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/12/): Seen from behind, a yellow sunflower leans toward the red bars and broad central post of a metal fence. Its green, bristled flower head and stem face the camera while the petals spread unevenly around them. Fine spiderwebs catch between the bars, and a sunlit garden falls out of focus beyond the fence.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/13/): A close view of a faded printed portrait showing a smiling astronaut with short dark hair and a moustache. His face is tinted pale pink and blue, with the circular collar of his spacesuit visible around his shoulders. Scuffs, creases and a small torn patch mark the image, while faint reflections and glare wash across its surface.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/14/): White capital letters spelling 'NEEDS' sit alone on a broad grey storefront panel. Strong sunlight throws a pattern of long diagonal shadows across the word and wall. Metal framing, a white drainpipe and cropped pale pink-and-white panels edge the otherwise spare composition.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/15/): Two orange-and-white traffic cones half swallowed by a glossy-leaved shrub against a grey wall. One stands upright behind the foliage; the other lies on its side in the foreground, its reflective white bands torn and peeling, on a bed of fallen red and pink leaves. The edge of a third cone stands at the right.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/16/): On a speckled concrete pavement, a person in jeans and pale pink trainers bends forward to hold out a hand to a small black dog. The dog, grey around the muzzle with white paws, wears a pink reflective harness and stretches its nose toward the open palm. A pink rope lead curves in from the left edge, and a black sandwich board and a bicycle wheel stand behind.
- [Photograph by John Braybrooke](https://johnbraybrooke.com/photos/17/): A black standard poodle stands on a pale wooden floor in a kitchen, dressed as a striped red-and-white popcorn box printed with POPCORN, with a fleecy cream ruff of popcorn at the neck. Its curly tail is raised, its mouth is wide open mid-yawn or mid-bark, and a pink flower hangs from its collar beside the tags. White cupboard doors and a steel fridge stand behind.

## Notes

- [Communication](https://johnbraybrooke.com/notes/2026-08-24-communication/): Him: [unintelligible] Her: Pardon? Him: Huh? Her: [unintelligible]
- [Strawberry Ice Cream](https://johnbraybrooke.com/notes/2026-06-29-strawberry-ice-cream/): At a crowded ice cream shop, a staff member held up a pink cone. "Who would like a strawberry ice cream? We made too much." After a pause, several hands went up. One man...
